messages:
maria: Heads-up — @simon is moving from CA (US) to ON (Canada) mid-June and asked about WFH stipend, payroll, and benefits. Tagging payroll/legal. TL;DR: does stipend continue? any tax nexus risk? 🤔
jen: Thanks @maria. Need the effective move date and new address. Stipend is usually prorated by pay period and country policy. If payroll transfers to Canada, stipend likely either converts to CAD or we pause during the transfer. I'll check the details.
simon: Move date is June 15. New address: Toronto. Still FTE, not contractor. Do I need to enroll in Canadian benefits right away or is there a temporary continuation of US coverage?
lisa: If payroll moves to Canadian entity or payroll provider, they must enroll in Canadian benefits. Some carriers have a 30-day waiting period; others are immediate. We need to know payroll switch date to advise properly.
alex: Legal note: cross-border employment triggers local employment law and withholding obligations. One headcount is low risk for corporate nexus, but cumulative presence matters. @kevin can confirm tax threshold details for province-level nexus.
kevin: For a single headcount moving to Ontario, we should be fine from a nexus perspective, but we must track days and keep a ledger. If we anticipate additional hires in Canada, start entity setup planning. Recommend using our global payroll partner (ADP Global / Deel) to simplify.
jen: Action items: 1) get Simon's signed Remote Location Change form; 2) payroll to confirm transfer cutover date; 3) benefits to confirm available Canadian plans and waiting periods; 4) People Ops to confirm stipend proration and FX handling.
maria: Dropping the cross-border checklist here: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/cross-border-checklist — Simon please fill the Remote Location Change form: https://forms.redwood.com/remote-change
simon: Form submitted. Quick Q: the $600 USD home office upgrade budget — can that be used while I'm in Canada?
lisa: Policy: home office budget reimburses equivalent local costs up to the USD cap. We reimburse in local currency at the equivalent cap. Submit Canadian receipts and we will reimburse in CAD up to the converted cap; approvals required.
alex: Also flag IT/asset import rules — if the company ships a laptop to Canada, customs and duties may apply. Options: ship via employee and expense customs, or coordinate Procurement to use a broker.
jen: Payroll note: final US payroll run will include prorated salary up to move date, then Canadian payroll begins next cycle. Stipend handling: final USD proration, new CAD stipend set at conversion rate on transfer date. Details and timeline in payroll KB.
hr-bot: Reminder: please complete the Tax Residency and New Location forms within 3 business days of the move to avoid benefit gaps.
maria: ✅ I'll follow up with a short email with timeline and owner assignments. If anyone sees a compliance red flag, please ping me directly so we can triage.
